name: The Land's End Hotel
stayType: Clifftop hotel with studios and countryside rooms
accommodation: Hotel rooms, Penwith Studios and The Saddle & Stablerooms
suitableFor: Couples and families exploring the far west
overview: A hotel at Land's End, a short drive or coastal walk from Sennen Cove. Besides the hotel rooms it has Penwith Studios and the rustic Saddle & Stablerooms, and there is a restaurant on site along with the First & Last Inn.
surfTripFit: It is close to Sennen, the most reliable surf beach in west Cornwall, and handy for exploring the whole Land's End peninsula.
